supported_facts.fact: The dissertation provenance surface rests on tracked scientific records. .agent-bridge packets are process coordination, are not the scientific record and are never dissertation evidence.

The clean-test contents were never inspected or used for development, model selection, or reporting decisions. Mechanical byte access occurred in two documented governance incidents, on 13 and 14 August 2026.

Incident A was the 13-August-2026 reviewer integrity-hash command. Incident B was the 14-August-2026 unscoped dependency-mapping traversal. Both are classification B mechanical byte access only, with no content inspection and no development, model-selection or reporting use.

Governance reporting distinguishes semantic inspection or use, mechanical byte access, and development/model-selection/reporting use. It prohibits the phrasings never accessed, unread and untouched, and prohibits any implication that only one access event occurred.
The clean-test structural counts are 8,013 questions and 972 images, referenced only through the already approved non-data Stage-1 pinning.

F1 has not been performed. F2 has not been performed and is unauthorised. No held-out clean-test result exists for any dissertation claim; every currently citable result is development-set evidence until F2.
